label: Combined Report
description: The Twitter report, run over one mixed link list. Same page as the Twitter report — letter, one post per page, a 4.9x7.0in image box, 0.75in margins, the engagement bar cropped out — with the pages grouped by network: every X post first, then Instagram, then Facebook. The links pages follow the same order, one list per network under its own heading. Sheet row order is kept inside each group.
